record.field: SELECT name, latest_version, state, write_date FROM ir_module_module WHERE state = 'installed' ORDER BY name

field.name: note
field.p: What it does: lists every installed module with its version and last update date.
Why: a module inventory is the first thing to attach to a support ticket or to compare two databases.
Dangers: none, read-only.

record.field: SELECT relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size, n_live_tup AS live_rows FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC LIMIT 30

field.name: note
field.p: What it does: shows the 30 biggest tables with their total size (data and indexes) and live row count.
Why: find bloat and oversized logs (mail messages, attachments, cron logs) before archiving or vacuuming.
Dangers: none, read-only. Statistics come from PostgreSQL and may be slightly outdated.

record.field: SELECT lower(email) AS email, count(*) AS qty, string_agg(id::text, ', ') AS partner_ids FROM res_partner WHERE email IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

field.name: note
field.p: What it does: groups contacts sharing the same email address (case-insensitive) and lists their ids.
Why: review candidates before using the standard contact merge tool.
Dangers: none, read-only. Companies and their contacts legitimately share an email in some setups.

record.field: SELECT vat, count(*) AS qty, string_agg(id::text, ', ') AS partner_ids FROM res_partner WHERE vat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

field.name: note
field.p: What it does: groups partners sharing the same VAT number and lists their ids.
Why: a company and its delivery or invoice addresses often carry the same VAT; real duplicates must be merged before accounting reports are trusted.
Dangers: none, read-only.

record.field: SELECT u.id, u.login, p.name, u.active, u.share, (SELECT max(l.create_date) FROM res_users_log l WHERE l.create_uid = u.id) AS last_login FROM res_users u JOIN res_partner p ON p.id = u.partner_id ORDER BY last_login DESC NULLS LAST

field.name: note
field.p: What it does: lists every user with login, name, active flag, portal flag and the date of the last login.
Why: audit licences, find dormant accounts to archive and check who really uses the system.
Dangers: none, read-only.

record.field: SELECT id, name, ref, date, state, journal_id, amount_total FROM account_move WHERE state = 'draft' ORDER BY date

field.name: note
field.p: What it does: lists draft journal entries and invoices with their journal and total.
Why: draft entries left behind distort reports and block period closing.
Dangers: none, read-only. Requires the Invoicing app: on a database without it the error message demonstrates how failures are reported.

record.field: SELECT q.product_id, q.location_id, q.lot_id, q.quantity FROM stock_quant q WHERE q.quantity < 0 ORDER BY q.quantity

field.name: note
field.p: What it does: lists negative stock quants per product, location and lot.
Why: negative stock must be investigated before inventory adjustments or valuation reports.
Dangers: none, read-only. Requires the Inventory app.

record.field: SELECT id, cron_name, active, nextcall, lastcall, interval_number, interval_type FROM ir_cron WHERE active AND nextcall < now() - interval '1 hour' ORDER BY nextcall

field.name: note
field.p: What it does: lists active scheduled actions whose next call is more than one hour in the past.
Why: stuck or long-running scheduler jobs are the usual cause of missing emails, stale reports and queued work.
Dangers: none, read-only. Fix the cause before touching nextcall by hand.
